campos.tema: Use Blade components for reusable UI
campos.descripcion: Extract repeated markup into named Blade components
campos.hacer: Use x-* components with @props for all reusable UI
campos.no_hacer: Duplicate HTML blocks across views

campos.descripcion: Define one master layout and extend it per page
campos.hacer: @extends layout with named @section blocks
campos.no_hacer: Duplicate header/footer HTML in every view

campos.descripcion: Declare accepted props inside components with @props
campos.hacer: @props with defaults to document component API
campos.no_hacer: Pass arbitrary variables without declaration

campos.descripcion: Build class strings conditionally without ternary noise
campos.hacer: @class directive for conditional class binding
campos.no_hacer: String concatenation or nested ternaries

campos.tema: Use named slots for flexible layouts
campos.descripcion: Named slots let callers inject content into specific regions
campos.hacer: @slot('header') and $slot for flexible component APIs
campos.no_hacer: Hard-code all sub-sections inside components

campos.tema: Use Blade directives instead of raw PHP
campos.descripcion: Blade directives are readable and IDE-supported
campos.hacer: @if @foreach @forelse @empty instead of <?php ?>
campos.no_hacer: Raw PHP tags inside Blade templates

campos.descripcion: Use double curly braces for XSS-safe output
campos.hacer: {{ }} for all user-supplied or dynamic text
campos.no_hacer: {!! !!} for untrusted data

campos.descripcion: Vite integration handles cache busting and HMR automatically
campos.hacer: @vite(['resources/css/app.css' 'resources/js/app.js'])
campos.no_hacer: Manual script/link tags with hardcoded paths

campos.descripcion: Two-way data binding keeps component state in sync
campos.hacer: wire:model for all form inputs managed by Livewire
campos.no_hacer: Manual JavaScript listeners syncing to component

campos.descripcion: Validate on input rather than only on submit
campos.hacer: wire:model.live + #[Validate] for instant feedback
campos.no_hacer: Only validate on form submit

campos.descripcion: Bind UI events to component methods cleanly
campos.hacer: wire:click for buttons and interactive elements
campos.no_hacer: JavaScript fetch calls replicating Livewire actions

campos.descripcion: mount() for init; updated() for reactive side effects
campos.hacer: mount() for initialization updatedFoo() for property changes
campos.no_hacer: Heavy logic in render() or __construct()

campos.tema: Use lazy loading for heavy components
campos.descripcion: Defer render of expensive components until visible
campos.hacer: wire:init or lazy attribute on components
campos.no_hacer: Load all Livewire components on page load

campos.tema: Integrate Alpine.js for local UI state
campos.descripcion: Use Alpine.js for UI-only state that doesn't need server round-trips
campos.hacer: x-data / x-show / x-transition for tooltips dropdowns
campos.no_hacer: Livewire server calls for purely visual toggle state

campos.descripcion: Always indicate to users when a server action is in progress
campos.hacer: wire:loading.attr="disabled" and wire:loading elements
campos.no_hacer: Provide no feedback while Livewire request is in flight

campos.descripcion: Livewire's trait manages chunked upload and temp storage
campos.hacer: WithFileUploads trait + wire:model for file inputs
campos.no_hacer: Manual multipart form submissions for Livewire pages

campos.tema: Use Inertia page components as route endpoints
campos.descripcion: Each page is a Vue/React component rendered server-side via Inertia::render()
campos.hacer: Inertia::render('Dashboard' ['data' => $data]) in controllers
campos.no_hacer: Return JSON and fetch from JavaScript

campos.descripcion: Middleware share() provides auth user and flash to every page
campos.hacer: Share auth/flash in HandleInertiaRequests middleware
campos.no_hacer: Pass auth to every Inertia::render() call

campos.descripcion: Inertia Link intercepts clicks for SPA-like transitions
campos.hacer: <Link href="/dashboard"> instead of <a href>
campos.no_hacer: Regular <a> tags for internal navigation

campos.tema: Use useForm for form state and submission
campos.descripcion: Inertia's useForm manages progress errors and transforms
campos.hacer: useForm for all page-level forms, form.post() for submit
campos.no_hacer: Axios/fetch for form submissions on Inertia pages

campos.tema: Use persistent layouts to preserve state
campos.descripcion: Wrap pages in a persistent layout so header/sidebar don't remount
campos.hacer: layout property on page component for persistent UI
campos.no_hacer: Re-render full layout on every page visit

campos.descripcion: Server-side rendering improves SEO and first paint
campos.hacer: Enable Inertia SSR for marketing and public pages
campos.no_hacer: Client-only rendering for all pages including public

campos.tema: Set up Tailwind CSS via Vite
campos.descripcion: Use Vite + tailwindcss plugin for fast HMR and optimized builds
campos.hacer: Install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite and configure vite.config.js
campos.no_hacer: Laravel Mix or manual PostCSS pipeline for new projects

campos.tema: Purge unused styles via content config
campos.descripcion: Tailwind scans Blade and JS files to tree-shake unused classes
campos.hacer: content: ['./resources/views/**/*.blade.php', './resources/js/**/*.{js,vue}']
campos.no_hacer: No content config — ship all 3MB of CSS

campos.descripcion: class-based dark mode integrates with server-rendered preference
campos.hacer: darkMode: 'class' with a toggle that sets class on <html>
campos.no_hacer: Media query only — no user override possible

campos.descripcion: Extract only truly repeated multi-class patterns
campos.hacer: @apply for BEM base classes shared across many components
campos.no_hacer: @apply for every single element — defeats Tailwind's purpose

campos.tema: Configure custom design tokens in CSS
campos.descripcion: Define brand colors spacing fonts as CSS variables consumed by Tailwind
campos.hacer: Custom @theme tokens matched to brand guidelines
campos.no_hacer: Magic color hex codes scattered across Blade templates

campos.tema: Use anonymous Blade components for UI primitives
campos.descripcion: Blade files in resources/views/components/ auto-register as x-* components
campos.hacer: Anonymous components for buttons alerts badges cards
campos.no_hacer: Blade @includes for anything reusable

campos.tema: Use class-based components for complex logic
campos.descripcion: PHP class components can inject services and pre-process data
campos.hacer: app/View/Components/ class when component needs PHP logic
campos.no_hacer: Blade @php blocks for business logic inside templates

campos.descripcion: Pass through HTML attributes like class id aria to root element
campos.hacer: $attributes->merge() on root element of components
campos.no_hacer: Ignore caller-provided HTML attributes silently

campos.descripcion: Keep variant/size/color logic in a PHP class or helper not in Blade
campos.hacer: Variant class or match() expression in component class
campos.no_hacer: Long @if chains for variants inside Blade templates

campos.descripcion: Use {{ $slot ?? '' }} or named slot defaults so components are usable empty
campos.hacer: Default content in slots for optional regions
campos.no_hacer: Require every slot to be filled — throws errors on empty usage

campos.descripcion: Prefix third-party or module components to avoid collisions
campos.hacer: Register custom prefix via Blade::componentNamespace()
campos.no_hacer: Mix first-party and package component names with no prefix

campos.descripcion: Move validation rules out of controllers into dedicated FormRequest classes
campos.hacer: php artisan make:request and define rules() + authorize()
campos.no_hacer: Inline validate() in controller actions

campos.tema: Preserve old input on validation failure
campos.descripcion: Use old() to repopulate form fields after server-side error redirect
campos.hacer: old('field') as default value on all form inputs
campos.no_hacer: Empty form fields when validation fails

campos.descripcion: Use the @error directive for inline field-level error messages
campos.hacer: @error('field') to show per-field messages
campos.no_hacer: Dump $errors->all() in one block at top of form

campos.tema: Use CSRF token on all forms
campos.descripcion: CSRF protection is enabled by default — include @csrf in every form
campos.hacer: @csrf in every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE form
campos.no_hacer: Disable VerifyCsrfToken middleware for convenience

campos.descripcion: HTML forms only support GET/POST — use @method for REST actions
campos.hacer: @method('PUT') inside form for update/delete routes
campos.no_hacer: Route::post for all mutations including updates

campos.descripcion: Flash success/error in controller; read in layout with session()
campos.hacer: session('status') in layout for global flash display
campos.no_hacer: Re-query DB or pass flash from every controller individually

campos.tema: Eager load relationships to prevent N+1
campos.descripcion: Always eager load related models used in views with with()
campos.hacer: with() in queries before passing collections to views
campos.no_hacer: Lazy-load relations inside Blade loops

campos.descripcion: Use cache() helper to wrap expensive rendered partials
campos.hacer: cache() around slow partials that change infrequently
campos.no_hacer: Re-render identical content on every request

campos.descripcion: Always paginate collections in list views
campos.hacer: ->paginate() or ->simplePaginate() with {{ $items->links() }}
campos.no_hacer: ->get() for large tables in views

campos.descripcion: Offload emails notifications and heavy processing to queues
campos.hacer: Dispatch jobs for anything taking >200ms
campos.no_hacer: Block HTTP request with slow operations

campos.descripcion: Laravel resolves models automatically — avoids manual find()
campos.hacer: Type-hint model in controller method
campos.no_hacer: Manual User::findOrFail($id) in every method

campos.tema: Enable HTTP response caching for static content
campos.descripcion: Cache control headers for pages that rarely change
campos.hacer: Cache-Control headers via middleware for public pages
campos.no_hacer: No caching — serve every response fresh

campos.descripcion: {{ }} auto-escapes HTML — never use {!! !!} on user data
campos.hacer: {{ }} for all untrusted or dynamic content
campos.no_hacer: {!! !!} for user-controlled strings

campos.tema: Protect routes with Gate and Policy
campos.descripcion: Use policies for authorization — never inline permission checks in views
campos.hacer: @can / Gate::allows() for UI visibility; policy()->authorize() for actions
campos.no_hacer: Hardcode role checks inline across templates

campos.descripcion: Check MIME type size and store outside public root
campos.hacer: Store in storage/app/private + validate mimes and max
campos.no_hacer: Store raw upload in public/ without validation

campos.tema: Use signed URLs for temporary links
campos.descripcion: Generate expiring URLs for private downloads or email confirmations
campos.hacer: URL::signedRoute() or temporarySignedRoute()
campos.no_hacer: Expose sequential IDs in download URLs without auth

campos.tema: Set a strict Content Security Policy
campos.descripcion: CSP headers prevent XSS injection of external scripts
campos.hacer: spatie/laravel-csp or custom middleware to emit CSP header
campos.no_hacer: No CSP — browser runs any injected script
